meta: Ask AI to compare insurance plans and read the exclusions: many people buy because the sales pitch sounds great, then find out what they need isn't covered.

muc.title: Buying because it sounds good
muc.text: Many people buy insurance because the pitch sounds great, then find out what they need isn't covered.

muc.title: Remove personal details
muc.text: Paste the benefits and exclusions into a chatbot, and remember to delete your name and policy number.

muc.title: Two plans side by side
muc.text: Ask AI to put two plans side by side: premium, benefits, waiting period and what's not covered.

muc.title: Questions for the agent
muc.text: Then ask AI to draft questions for the agent. AI helps you understand; the decision is yours.

muc.title: Three exclusions
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to summarize three things your current insurance doesn't cover.

thu: Ask a chatbot to summarize three things your current insurance doesn't cover.
